final_assessment: All 17 findings from the first fresh proposal pass walked to resolution; zero stale, zero deferred, zero escalated. Twelve took the obvious-fix lane and five the decision lane, all five ratified by one chat directive. The pass diagnosis held under the walk: the scenario BODIES were byte-identical as the change claimed, and what had rotted was what the surviving scenarios ASSERT — three still demanded budgetExhausted and the BUDGET-SPENT token beneath a paragraph declaring both retired. One shape produced most of the findings: the change swept its vocabulary through the paragraphs it rewrote and stopped at their edges — the requirement own opening SHALL, the scenarios below it, a sibling requirement outside the delta, and a terminal render two files over. Three consequences worth carrying. (1) The delta gained a 7th MODIFIED requirement, spec-driven v1 gates and cadence, because leaving it would ship a falsehood into baseline; that took the delta to 62,555 B — 153% of R-crc-1 byte ceiling — now RECORDED with its measured 81% mandatory-reproduction split rather than explained away, and inside the ceiling on all three dimensions R-crc-1 trusts more. (2) Finding 12 near-identical-looking version pin was deliberately NOT fixed, on the distinction that it is currently TRUE where finding 5 prose is FALSE; task 4.1 now carries that answer so the sweep is closed rather than open. (3) Design D6 records that this change DIVERGES from its own stage charter by deleting the predicate the charter said R-crc-11 does not delete — the reversal is sound and user-grounded, and it was previously unrecorded anywhere. The architecture doc is untouched; the amendment is recommended to /orbit:architect per R-crc-6.
